Mountain views from every room

Mountain views from every room

ZAR 2,600,000~€139,437
  • 2 Bedrooms
  • 2 Bathrooms
  • ~65 m² Living area

Description

We are proud to present this 65sqm open plan two bed, two bath apartment at the Airbnb friendly Perspectives block. This apartment has breath-taking Table mountain views from all the rooms. Tiled throughout with a wood look alike, air-con in all the rooms, this stunning apartment has been tastefully renovated for the desiring buyer. The open plan kitchen displays great use of space with plumbing available for both washing machine and tumble dryer. The living area boasts floor to ceiling sliding doors along with large windows making you feel like you are on top of the mountain. Both bedrooms are fitted with BIC. Further benefits include a roof-top entertainment area with pool, gym and braai facilities. This property has two secure parking bays along with 24 hour security. Ideally located with easy access onto the N2 and a stone throw away from Wembley Square Virgin Active, Gardens Shopping Centre ,walking distance to the MyCiTi bus stop and the City Centre. Additional features include 1)Automatic water cut off switch to the geyser with an audible alarm in case of a leakage. 2)On line water meter monitoring usage via app. 3) Fibre line. Exclusive mandate Price R2,600,000.00 Levies R4,692.00 Rates R1,280.00
